Michigan has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus of any big Great Lakes university. Indiana is 86 behind.

Every Great Lakes university with 20,000+ students:

1. Michigan: 224
2. Indiana: 138
3. Cincinnati: 101
4. Ohio State: 86
4. Wisconsin: 86
6. Michigan State: 84
7. Ohio University: 63
8. Purdue: 61
9. Wayne State: 59
10. IU Indianapolis: 27
11. UW-Milwaukee: 24
12. Grand Valley State: 8
13. Kent State: 5

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/rankings/
